*** PRE-WINDOW. This is from Sunday MORNING - roughly eleven hours BEFORE last night's 20:26 edition. It is NOT an overnight development. ***
Al Jazeera's own headline is "Trump calls for Ukraine ELECTION, says Zelenskyy failed to end war" - the word "REPLACE" is a standfirst/aggregation gloss and TRUMP DID NOT SAY IT. Do not put "replace" in his mouth.

AJ video blurb in full: "US President Donald Trump has called for Ukraine to hold elections, implying Zelenskyy missed opportunities to end the war with Russia. Trump also criticised Ukrainian attacks on Russian oil sites that have driven up global prices, a day after Washington announced a diesel supply deal with Moscow."

WHAT TRUMP ACTUALLY SAID (from BBC and Guardian, both approved, both already cached):
- Trump said it was "time for Ukraine to get a new president" (BBC); "time for Ukraine to get a new president" who would finally settle the war (Guardian). Said on SATURDAY, after Zelensky condemned the diesel deal.
- Trump accused Zelensky of wanting to "make problems for the world" by continuing to authorise attacks on Russian refineries, and said Zelenskyy should "damn well stop" hitting Russian refineries.
TIED TO BOTH: the refinery strikes AND the diesel deal - the remarks came in response to Zelensky's criticism of the diesel deal, and Trump's complaint was about the refinery strikes driving up prices.

UKRAINIAN RESPONSE (already in hand, Sunday):
- Zelenskyy to US ABC News: "First of all, with all respect to President Trump, it's up to our society, up to our people to choose one or another leader."
- He pledged to hold elections - suspended under the Ukrainian constitution during wartime - only if Russia agreed to a TOTAL 60-DAY CEASEFIRE.
- UK: "Britain stands behind Zelenskyy, says Streeting after Trump's call for new leader in Ukraine" - theguardian.com/politics/2026/oct/11/britain-stands-behind-zelenskyy-streeting-trump-ukraine (Sun 11 Oct 10:03 BST).

RECOMMENDATION: do NOT run this as a new or lead item. It is Saturday's remark, surfaced by a Sunday-morning AJ video, and it has been overtaken twice over - by the energy-ceasefire claim and then by Zelensky saying Russia struck power plants after it. Its proper place is one clause of context inside the Ukraine lead ("days after Trump said it was time Ukraine got a new president"). Running it as fresh would be a window error.
